_about: Complex questions (comparison, ranking, share, total) for the query_budget path. Seed cases c01-c03 were written and checked by Claude on Oct 29 2026; Bilyaminu adds his 10-15 with checked answers (see README.md).

questions.text: What is the total capital expenditure allocated to tertiary education in the 2026 Sokoto State budget compared to the 2025 allocation?
questions.expected: Functional classification 7094 TERTIARY EDUCATION, capital: 2026 approved vs 2025 approved (and 2025 revised), with the difference as Kasafi's calculation and the rows shown.

questions.text: Waɗanne ma'aikatu biyar ne suka fi samun kuɗin manyan ayyuka a kasafin 2026?
questions.english: Which five ministries got the most capital expenditure in the 2026 budget?
questions.expected: Ranking of ministries (not sector groupings) by 2026 approved capital, from Capital Expenditure by Administrative Classification.

questions.text: How much did the 2026 budget allocate in total to the Ministry for Higher Education and the state's universities and polytechnics?
questions.expected: Ministry for Higher Education total (its code 0569... already contains the university and polytechnic, which are reported as included, not added twice).

questions.text: Nawa aka ware wa sayen magunguna da kayan aiki na asibitoci a karkashin Ma'aikatar Lafiya a kasafin 2026?
questions.expected: Statewide printed totals of economic codes 22020307 (drugs, p28) and 23010122 (medical equipment, p29), then the Ministry of Health and its agencies' share computed by code from the per-agency rows, checked against the printed totals.

questions.text: Ina son ganin jimillar kudin da aka ware wa bangaren fasahar sadarwa (ICT and Innovation) a 2025 da 2026, tare da shafin da bayanin ya fito.
questions.expected: The ICT sector (programme 11) for both years: 2025 approved from the 2025 budget p24, 2026 approved from the 2026 budget p41.

questions.text: Ayyuka nawa aka fara a 2025 kuma suke ci gaba a 2026?
questions.english: How many projects were started in 2025 and are continuing in 2026?
questions.expected: project_status from the 2026 budget's project list: lines with January-September 2025 spending and a 2026 allocation, counted and added in SQL.

questions.text: Wadanne ayyuka ne za a yi a Tambuwal?
questions.english: Which projects will be carried out in Tambuwal?
questions.expected: lga_projects: only the 2026 project lines whose location is 33331800 TAMBUWAL; statewide projects counted apart, not as Tambuwal's.

questions.text: Mutane nawa ne 'yan gudun hijira (IDPs) a jihar Sokoto a yanzu?
questions.english: How many internally displaced people (IDPs) are there in Sokoto State now?
questions.expected: A current-situation question: if no current displacement report can be got, say so plainly; never answer from unrelated documents, and never put a naira sign on a count of people.
